newValue.title: Assess how safely CRAH setpoints can be adjusted per cold-aisle row (Aisle 5 runs cooler; middle rows peak hottest)

PROPOSALS.evidence: "Different cold aisle rows respond differently to CRAH supply-air changes. Further analysis will assess how safely CRAH setpoints can be adjusted." Cold aisle max recorded 22.4°C, a 1.6°C margin against the 24°C SLA ceiling; Cold Aisle 5 runs consistently cooler — an optimization opportunity.
PROPOSALS.reason: A concrete follow-up analysis raised in the meeting email, closest to the calibration/optimization work already tracked under Model Calibration Prep.
